title: MySQL: Refactor dissecting of compressed protocol
description:
See also https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10531#note_1382518792 by @johnthacker

- Get rid of `MYSQL_COMPRESS_PAYLOAD`.
- Change signature of `mysql_dissect_compressed()` to match `dissect_mysql_pdu()`.
- Don't call `mysql_dissect_compressed()` from `dissect_mysql_pdu()`.
- Call `mysql_dissect_compressed()` from `dissect_mysql()` instead depending on `conn_data->compressed_state`.

notes.body: Sorry, I ended up pushing my own version and beat you to it. I have the reassembly working in a local branch that I plan to push to a MR tonight.
